title: MamashooterXPolygon
tagline: Its a 2d platform game which can be run on browser and it is made using gdevelop and javascript. After the game you can mint nfts to keep as an asset.
description:
Get ready for the ultimate gaming experience! We've created a thrilling 2D platform game using GDevelop that will keep you on the edge of your seat from start to finish. And that's just the beginning.

After completing the game, you'll have the opportunity to mint your own NFTs! With our innovative Dapp integration, you'll be able to seamlessly create unique, one-of-a-kind assets that can be traded and collected with other players
how_its_made:
We've developed an exciting 2D platform game using GDevelop that's sure to delight gamers of all ages. But that's not all. We've also added a revolutionary new feature that allows players to mint their own NFTs!

Through the seamless integration of a Dapp, players can easily create their own unique assets after completing the game. This creates a whole new dimension of gameplay, making our platform a true P2E (Play-to-Earn) game.

With our innovative technology, we've created an unforgettable gaming experience that goes beyond mere entertainment. So come and join us for an adventure that's both thrilling and rewarding!
